subject: Air freight quote: CGN to DFW
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well. Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option from CGN to DFW (Dallas, US)?

We’ll deliver the textile samples to Cologne airport (CGN) ourselves, so there’s no need to arrange pickup. The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-27 and consists of 4 pieces, with a gross weight of 85 kg and a total volume of 0.70 cbm.

Thanks for your help!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
